thread:
Amy: Quick sync — AcmeHealth auditor emailed a list for the POC evidence packet. They want: 1) data-flow cartography showing which services touch PHI, 2) clear list of "in-scope" infra/components for SOC2/ISO, 3) a signed pen-test attestation (who can sign + timeline), 4) what SSL/cert metadata we can share for on-prem (CN/issuer/thumbprint?), and 5) pricing impact if they require reserved staging capacity. Deadline: next Tue EOD. Any blockers?

Raj: Ill create a network/service flow diagram with CIDRs and SG/NSG rules. Do they need host-level IPs or is service-level CIDRs fine?

Amy: Auditor okay with service-level flows + CIDRs. They want traceability so the diagram entries must map to an asset list.

Marta (Security): Pen-test attestation: Security can sign our standard operational attestation. Legal must approve any bespoke wording. Typical attestation text: "Redwood Inference attests that a penetration test was completed on <date> covering systems listed in attached scope; summary of findings attached." Signed letter available ~3 business days after final vendor report. If Acme requests the vendors full report, we'll need an NDA and vendor consent (~+2 days).

Chad (Solutions): Pricing: reserved staging/dedicated hosts add a premium (~+25-40% depending on GPU class). For a short POC recommend ephemeral burst capacity or a short reserved term. I can draft a side-by-side: ephemeral vs reserved once Amy confirms expected vGPU count and peak QPS.

Amy: Certs/KMS: Acme asks for proof certs are customer-managed for Private. For on-prem POC they asked whether we can provide CN + issuer or only a thumbprint.

Marta (Security): We can provide CN + issuer and a redacted thumbprint. Never share private keys or internal rotation secrets. For KMS integration we can provide key metadata and a short runbook describing rotation and ACLs; screenshots that include customer IDs need Legal sign-off.

Raj: Sample SG snippet I'll attach:```- lb-subnet (10.0.1.0/24) -> app-subnet (10.0.2.0/24): allow 443
- app-subnet -> db-subnet (10.0.3.0/24): allow 5432
- peered-acme (172.16.0.0/16): allow 443 from whitelisted hosts```PNG + draw.io XML by EOD.

Redwood Bot: Uploaded: pen-test-attestation-template.pdf to https://drive.redwood.example/attestations/4298765432 (owner: Marta) :white_check_mark:

Marta (Security): Uploaded redlined attestation template. Ill prepare a 1-page "in-scope assets" list that aligns with Raj's diagram. Legal to review signature block.

Chad (Solutions): Amy — once POC capacity confirmed Ill produce cost split and note performance/SLA variance for ephemeral.

Amy: Action list: Raj -> diagram + SG rules (EOD today). Marta -> attestation + in-scope list (tomorrow). Chad -> cost comparison (EOD). Ill consolidate and send to Acme auditor Mon AM. If they request vendor full report, we need NDA + vendor approval which may bump timeline.

Marta (Security): FYI if Acme wants CT logs we can include public CT entries; private cert internals are off-limits.

Amy: Thanks team. :pray:
